# OB.1 AI Solutions

> Audit-first AI consulting and Governance as a Service (GaaS) for mid-market companies. Rules Before Tools: OB.1 maps, governs, and monitors AI adoption before tools get deployed, with a lawyer-in-the-loop methodology.

OB.1 AI Solutions helps mid-market executives (CEO, COO, CRO, CCO, General Counsel, CISO) in finance, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, and professional services adopt AI safely. The signature deliverable is the Operational Blueprint: a diagnostic that produces an AI readiness scorecard, a prioritized opportunity map, and an implementation roadmap. Governance as a Service extends that into continuous, adaptive governance: policy generation, agentic monitoring of business data, and ongoing compliance support. Based in Northeast Ohio, serving the United States.
